threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'Dalston Junction' instead of just 'Junction' when talking Tube stops, bless your heart.
Last night on the 196, a guy serenaded the whole bus with a broken guitar—everyone joined in on the chorus. Never seen such unity at 2 AM.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: One morning, I saw a guy juggling flaming torches while on a bike, and a group of kids joined in riding their scooters around him. Classic Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Kreuzberg, it’s not just about the currywurst; some places also serve it in a döner bread. Only here would you find fusion fast food at 3 AM.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You spot a real local when they roll their eyes at tourists at Dolores Park trying to figure out the bus routes. They know the 14 is always a gamble.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 19 bus at 7:45pm, packed with folks shouting over each other. It's like the city's heartbeat, with stories spilling out at every stop.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about hip cafes; they miss the quiet corners where locals still gather for a game of boules by the fountain.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by their bewildered faces at the Mercat de l'Abaceria, fumbling with the cash register and asking for 'un baguette' instead of pa.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot a newbie when they’re still waiting for the bus at 2 AM, clueless that the Night Tube isn’t a myth anymore.
Caught a guy trying to sell homemade candles on the 133 last night. Smelled like lavender and desperation, but hey, who buys them at 2 AM?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a group of kids sketching a mural on the old wall by Weserstrasse, while their parents argued about the best kebab place nearby.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find tech startups sharing the same building with old Turkish bakeries. A blend of innovation and tradition you won’t find anywhere else.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they're from here when they know to avoid BART after a game—last night's match had folks jumping on every bus, smoke or no smoke.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading waiting passengers on the 31 bus with an acoustic guitar. Whole crowd cracked smiles—only in SF!

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just stop on Carrer Verdi for a selfie; locals know to keep moving or risk a verbal avalanche of 'feu el favor!'

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot a newcomer by their bewildered look when the tram stops 100 meters before the station. It's like they never expect it.
